name: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group, Inc.
summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group, Inc. operates as a trust bank in Japan and internationally. It operates through Wealth Management Business, Corporate Business, Investor Services Business, Real Estate Business, Global Markets Business, and Asset Management Business segments. The company offers services to individuals, corporate, investors, as well as to real estate business. It is also involved in marketing, market-making, investment, financial management, and asset management services operations.
